sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, market_ticker AS a, coalesce(market_status,'-') AS b, coalesce(max(last_seen_at)::text,'-') AS c FROM incentive_programs WHERE market_ticker IN ('KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26-7.0','KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26-6.8','KXRT-RES-93','KXRT-RES-94','KXRT-RES-97') GROUP BY market_ticker, market_status) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, p.market_ticker, coalesce(p.quantity::text,'-'), max(p.captured_at)::text FROM positions p WHERE p.captured_at > now() - interval '20 minutes' AND (p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26%' OR p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXRT-RES%') GROUP BY p.market_ticker, p.quantity)) u ORDER BY g, a
